title: Counterpoint is a series of articles where we apply longer t
text:
Counterpoint is a series of articles where we apply longer term thinking in response to a hot topic in the news in order to gain a balanced investment perspective. 

Source: Latest Consumer Technology Products On Display At Annual CES In Las Vegas 
One of the many highlights at the ongoing 2018 CES in Las Vegas is the showcase of everything voice-enabled. Every company is putting their best foot forward in order to demonstrate their expertise and development in what will be the next great technological battle.
Here is our point-based Counterpoint report on why Google (NASDAQ: GOOG ) (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) investors should not fear Amazon's ( AMZN ) lead in voice-enabled devices.
1. Amazon has an impressive early lead Industry surveys report that Amazon currently has a 70-80% share of the smart speaker market, compared to 20-30% for Google (Source: techcrunch.com ). This market is currently a two-horse race with Apple's (NASDAQ: AAPL ) Siri, Microsoft's (NASDAQ: MSFT ) Cortana, and Samsung's ( OTC:SSNLF ) Bixby-enabled devices trailing far behind.
Various media reports from CES 2018 agree that Amazon has the momentum at the moment. It has been releasing more voice-enabled devices in the last year from cameras to alarm clocks while concurrently growing Amazon Alexa's portfolio of skills to over 30,000, allowing users to do more with their devices (Source: businessinsider.com ).
